description: Elections Commission - N. S. K. J. Abeywardhana of the Pitabeddara Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated  his member of the Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna - J. W. Kulawansha of the Pitabeddara Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated member of the Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna - G. M. Anura of the Pitabeddar Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his member of the Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna
reasoning: This gazette contains multiple notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific individuals have vacated their office as members of the Pitabeddara Pradeshiya Sabha due to ceasing membership in a political party. This content directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials in local government, making it clearly fall under Elections Gazettes (Type 7).
